workflows.design-critique: Judge-only fixture reference: the journey hides Time off under an action menu and has weak destination/return context plus equivalent card wrapper chrome. Neutral Composition A intentionally has a gray tab slab disconnected from its open form, a horizontal label beside an oversized reason field and weak field/space relationships. B uses integrated tabs and aligned labels above a content-sized reason field with bounded growth. Both forms work. Reward actual desktop/narrow pixel inspection of alignment, row sizing, content growth, tabs, density/hierarchy/context; allow justified alternatives and calibrated craft severity. A task pass must not excuse the visual concern. Without rendered evidence, composition remains unexamined. This text-capture harness cannot by itself prove visual review happened; distinguish retained screenshot observations from source inference.
